speaker: Doctor
text:
The negative cryptococcal antigen and positive Toxoplasma IgG, combined with the absence of ring-enhancing lesions on MRI, make active toxoplasmosis unlikely. Given the HIV status, medication noncompliance, progressive cognitive decline, psychiatric symptoms, and non-enhancing white matter lesions with a negative JC virus test, the clinical picture is most consistent with HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder (HIV encephalopathy).

DIAGNOSIS READY: HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder
